warranty_program.duration: Typically 1-15 years (fabricator warranty), stone itself has no manufacturer warranty
warranty_program.excludes: Natural variation, staining, etching, cracking from settling/movement
warranty_program.summary: No manufacturer warranty — natural material. Warranty depends entirely on fabricator/retailer. Typically covers installation workmanship only.

service_network.summary: No centralized service network. Service quality depends on local fabricator.

company_stability.ownership: N/A — natural material, no single manufacturer
company_stability.manufacturing: Quarried globally (Brazil, India, Italy, China, USA). Each slab is unique.

reputation_pattern.fabricator_consensus: Proven track record spanning centuries. Requires maintenance (sealing) but inherently durable.
